FEAT-5-S100.title: Allowlist Enforcement and Tool Rejection Paths
FEAT-5-S100.description: Implement strict allowlist checking for all incoming tool requests, rejecting any tool not explicitly registered and returning a safe, structured error response.

FEAT-5-S101.title: Structured Error Handling and Response Normalization
FEAT-5-S101.description: Standardize success and failure responses from tool execution, including validation errors, execution exceptions, and unknown tool cases, ensuring consistent schema returned to the agent loop.

FEAT-5-S102.title: Chat History Injection into Tool Context
FEAT-5-S102.description: Inject relevant chat history into tool execution context where required, ensuring downstream services receive sufficient conversational state for accurate processing.

FEAT-5-S103.title: Debug Logging and Audit Trace for Tool Routing
FEAT-5-S103.description: Integrate tool routing with debug_logger to capture tool selection, validation results, execution timing, and errors for auditability and troubleshooting.
